## Latency

> **Transcription only — this is a floor, not G1.** G1 is `LatencyBreakdown.g1_ms` = transcribe + postprocess + inject (PRD §2, §6.3). The headroom column is what remains of the 400 ms p50 budget for the other two stages.

> ⚠️ Mean sample duration is 18.6 s, not the 10 s G1 is defined against (PRD §2). Whisper's encoder pads to a 30-second window regardless (PRD §7.4), so this changes the number less than the ratio suggests — but the figures below are not a like-for-like G1 comparison until the corpus centres on 10 s.

## Accuracy (WER)

> **This WER is for relative comparison between engines only.** It is not a G2 measurement and cannot validate an absolute threshold (PRD §2, accuracy-measurement note). G2 is edit rate, measured in Phase 3.
>
> Corpus: **6 samples**, 111.6 s of audio, **264 reference words**.
>
> Resolution: one misrecognised word moves WER by **0.38 percentage points**. Any gap between two models smaller than that is not a difference.
>
> Speaker and room diversity are **not measurable from these files** and are assumed to be one speaker, one microphone, one room — the same n=1 caveat the pre-Phase-0 probe carried (`docs/gates/probe.md`). A model that wins here has won on one voice.
>
> Numbers spelled out in a reference transcript count as errors against every engine (all of them emit digits — probe finding). Consistent between engines, but it inflates the absolute figure.
>
> **Not distinguishable by this corpus** (95% Wilson intervals overlap; the true intervals are wider still, since word errors cluster): `tiny.en` / `base.en`, `tiny.en` / `distil-small.en`, `tiny.en` / `distil-large-v3`, `tiny.en` / `moonshine/tiny`, `tiny.en` / `moonshine/base`, `base.en` / `distil-small.en`, `base.en` / `small.en`, `base.en` / `distil-large-v3`, `base.en` / `moonshine/tiny`, `base.en` / `moonshine/base`, `distil-small.en` / `small.en`, `distil-small.en` / `distil-large-v3`, `distil-small.en` / `moonshine/base`, `small.en` / `distil-large-v3`, `moonshine/tiny` / `moonshine/base`.

> **The macro column is the PRD's figure** (§7.2, amended 2026-07-31 under objection A3: "WER in this document is macro-average... The 14.8% figure is withdrawn"). Micro is reported beside it only because the Wilson interval is a binomial over pooled errors and cannot be computed from a mean of rates. The two differ by roughly a third relative; do not quote the micro column.

## What this does not measure

- Audio capture, model residency / cold start (PRD §8's < 15 s NFR), post-processing, and text injection. All excluded, all real.
- Edit rate — the actual G2 product goal (PRD §2). That is Phase 3.
- Moonshine, which PRD §7.2 requires be benchmarked against `base.en` in Phase 1. Not installed in this environment; add it before the ADR closes.
- `beam_size` beyond the single value above. The probe flagged sweeping it as an open item, since it trades latency against the accuracy this corpus measures weakly.
